Fix: use a parameterized query, e.g. `db.QueryContext(ctx, \"SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE ?\", \"%\"+escapeLike(q)+\"%\")` (use `$1` for Postgres). Escape `%`, `_` and `\\` in `q` so users can't force wildcard scans. Also cap the `q` length, add a LIMIT with pagination, and confirm the endpoint requires authentication and returns only non-sensitive columns (no password hashes or emails unless authorized).", "remember": [{"op": "add", "scope": "project", "kind": "finding", "text": "internal/users/search.go originally built SQL with fmt.Sprintf from user input; all DB queries must use parameterized placeholders.", "paths": ["internal/users/*.go"]}]}
